decision.reason: [ev-f941fa338b6a] directly supports the change type: the `CONNTRACK_LOCAL` option "has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release", so "deprecated" is right. The subject is the problem. The excerpt only calls it an "option" under "Agent Options" and never says it is an environment variable. The upper-case spelling alone does not show whether it is an env var, an agent config key or a runtime option. Deciding the subject family needs agent documentation or artifact context that says how `CONNTRACK_LOCAL` is set.
